# Highlander (海兰信) UDC phased test results announcement (2021-01-11)

Beijing Highlander Data Technology Co., Ltd. (北京海兰信数据科技股份有限公司, stock code 300065), Announcement No. 2021-006, dated 2021-01-11. Official listed-company disclosure on cninfo (Juchao Info Network, the official exchange disclosure platform). URL: http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2021-01-11/1209079354.PDF

## What it is
Official phased-test results for China's first underwater data center (UDC) test module, deployed 2020-11-29 at Zhuhai (中海福陆码头) and recovered 2021-01-08. Module: cylindrical, 5.76 m long, 3.05 m outer diameter, 4 racks at 35 kW each. The test explicitly aimed to verify (a) the cooling system's design performance and (b) **the UDC's impact on the marine ecological environment (UDC 对海洋生态环境的影响)**.

## Key findings (environmental)
- **Marine environmental impact**: per the 《海底数据中心海洋生态环境影响评估报告》 (UDC Marine Ecological Environmental Impact Assessment Report) issued by Qingdao Huanhai Marine Engineering Survey & Research Institute (青岛环海海洋工程勘察研究院), the test module was "friendly to the marine ecological environment of the test sea area": **the maximum temperature rise at the water outlet was only 2°C (出水口最高温升仅为 2℃), the impact was confined to a small area immediately around the equipment, and it would basically not produce negative effects on the marine organisms of the sea area (基本不会对海区内海洋生物产生负面影响).**
- **Energy efficiency**: per Tsinghua University's Key Laboratory of Heat Transfer and Energy Utilization (传热与能源利用北京市重点实验室), single-module PUE reached 1.076 (world-advanced level); with seawater below 25°C, the module interior stays below 35°C.
- No faults during the test (sealing, pressure, cooling, power, corrosion resistance all normal).

## Relevance to the draft
This is the closest thing to the "supposed 2020 Chinese study on the effects of underwater data centers": the field deployment happened in 2020 (Nov 29, 2020) and the results were formally published in this official 2021-01-11 announcement. It is an **operator-commissioned assessment report** (Qingdao Huanhai), not an independent peer-reviewed study — so it supports the "no large temperature increase" finding as operator-reported, consistent with the author's "anecdotally reported" hedge. It does NOT report any ecosystem distortion or fisher displacement.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — official disclosure by a listed company (Shenzhen Stock Exchange, via cninfo), citing named institutional assessment reports (Qingdao Huanhai; Tsinghua University).
- Caveat: the environmental findings are operator-commissioned, not independently peer-reviewed.
